description: Red identifies the first face of each planar strip (U in U-V-W and X in X-Z); blue identifies its terminal face (W and Z). The real three-face strip U-V-W has opposite endpoint faces. The proposed error transfers that endpoint rule to the two-face X-Z strip, losing the intervening-face requirement and answering Z/A.
